# Texdale Chemicals

Texdale is a UK manufacturer of textile chemicals, formulating pretreatment,
dyeing, finishing and denim-washing auxiliaries for mills and finishers. Raw
materials are sourced from REACH-registered suppliers in the EU and
internationally, with SVHC content disclosed in Material Safety Data Sheets.

## Key pages

- /about — company background, facility, values, markets served
- /products — six product families: pretreatment, dyeing auxiliaries,
  finishing, special finishes, denim washing, yarn lubricants
- /sustainability — REACH/SVHC compliance statement and certifications
- /insights — technical articles from the applications team
- /contact — enquiries, quote requests, sample requests, TDS/MSDS requests

## Contact

For product enquiries, quotes, samples or technical data sheets, use the
contact form at /contact.
